validity.researcher_notes: Westlake Expansion Project — Gulf South Pipeline (Boardwalk). Verified across 27 EIA quarterly releases (May 2018 through Aug 2026) with identical specs. Primary source: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook. FERC docket CP17-476 (Interstate lateral). Project purpose: Lake Charles Power Plant gas supply. 0.3-mile, 16-inch, 200 MMcf/d lateral completed 2019. Currently operating; no abandonment or idling recorded. Route geometry not yet digitized (P5976.geojson is null geometry). Owner: Boardwalk Pipeline Partners (holding company for Gulf South Pipeline). All specifications verified.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Westlake Expansion Project completed August 2019. Status 'Completed' in EIA (= operating). Consistent reporting in all 27 EIA quarterly releases through August 2026. No abandonment, idling, or status-change notices found. In-service year 2019 confirmed. Current status 'operating' confirmed. No recent changes detected.
